title: Mafia Mystery
subtitle: Digital Card Game
overview: A digital version of the card game Mafia built with React and TypeScript, with real-time multiplayer via WebSockets.
challenge: Translate the social deduction mechanics of Mafia into an online experience with lobbies, phases, and live player interaction.
solution: Implemented game lobbies with shareable codes, night and day phases with voting, and WebSocket connectivity for real-time play.

sections.title: Gameplay
sections.content: Players join via lobby codes, move through night and day rounds, and vote in real time — all synced across connected clients.
